title: Pakalum Paathiravum
overview: Michael, a wildlife photographer travelling to Mysore, stops at a farmer's house for the night when his bike breaks down. What happens when Mercy, the farmer's daughter, finds a gun in Michael's bag?

songs.title: Manamele Poovithalai (From "Pakalum Paathiravum")
songs.singers: Sujesh Hari, Stephen Devassy, Nithya Mammen
